answer: Latency-Ledger Entry Rule. Each identity must answer a rotating challenge within a tight window; correct responses are logged on a shared ledger like a jetty gating traffic. Cloned identities replaying cached answers miss the timing window and are rejected. Every new identity also posts a fable-marked nonce tied to the prior epoch, so bulk clones inherit stale proofs. A zephyr-fast sweep clears unconfirmed entries each round, charging attackers the compute and missed-window penalty per clone.
